instruction: Reopen the recently closed www.tripadvisor.com tab to restore all three travel sites.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reopening the TripAdvisor tab. The evaluator uses is_expected_tabs to check all 3 tabs (Lonely Planet, Airbnb, TripAdvisor) are open. Agent should use Chrome's recently closed tab restoration (keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+T or History menu). No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_open_tabs_info properly retrieves all open tabs with their URLs
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_tabs checks if expected URLs match actual URLs using list comparison with compare_urls
Expected values are correct: All three URLs (lonelyplanet.com, airbnb.com, tripadvisor.com) are properly specified
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks for all three tabs as required by the instruction
The instruction requirement 'all three travel sites open again' is fully verified by checking presence of all three URLs
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Potential issue: are_lists_equal may be order-sensitive. If the implementation checks order, the evaluator might fail if the agent reopens TripAdvisor in a different tab position (e.g., first instead of third). Consider using set comparison instead of ordered list comparison for tab URLs.
Minor consideration: Ensure compare_urls handles URL variations (http/https, www/non-www, trailing slashes) robustly, though this is likely already implemented in the utility function.
